body:
The sunlight blazed down through the tree leaves overhead, casting an orange glow on the ground. I felt a flutter in my chest as I scanned the volunteers gathered around the makeshift tent. Their faces were etched with tired expressions, but their eyes held a determination I recognized as genuine. 

I made my way over silently, wrapping my arms loosely around one of their shoulders. "We got this," I whispered into their ear. "Stay steady." My fingers found the fabric of their shirt, pulling it tight against their back as if sealing them off from the world outside. "Just take deep breaths, okay? It’s going to be okay."

The sunlight blazed down through the tree leaves overhead, casting an orange glow on the ground. I felt a flutter in my chest as I scanned the volunteers gathered around the makeshift tent. Their faces were etched with tired expressions, but their eyes held a determination I recognized as genuine. 

I made my way over silently, wrapping my arms loosely around one of their shoulders. "We got this," I whispered into their ear. "Stay steady." My fingers found the fabric of their shirt, pulling it tight against their back as if sealing them off from the world outside. "Just take deep breaths, okay? It’s going to be okay."

Next: stay beside them and keep them steady.
